name: BulkGrab - Bulk File Downloader
description: Bulk file downloader that detects, selects, and downloads downloadable files from webpages with freemium and ZIP export options.

_comment_permissions_justification.downloads: Required to download user-selected files (such as PDFs, images, archives, audio, and documents) detected on webpages directly to the user's local Downloads directory without repetitive manual save prompts.
_comment_permissions_justification.activeTab: Required to inspect the current webpage for downloadable media links only when invoked by the user via the extension action, strictly avoiding broad <all_urls> permissions.
_comment_permissions_justification.scripting: Required to dynamically inject the DOM file scanner and interactive floating grabber panel into the active tab on user demand.
_comment_permissions_justification.storage: Required to persist user license status (Free vs. Pro) and track session download counts for free-tier quota enforcement.

_comment_host_permissions: Left empty by default. activeTab and scripting handle active pages upon user action. To scope to specific sites, add URL patterns like 'https://example.com/*' into host_permissions below.
